parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, designed to be pressed by hand.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the actuator that dispenses liquid when pressed, controlling the flow of soap or shampoo.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and nozzle, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the nozzle, ensuring smooth dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the pressing lid to the internal pump.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the dispenser, made of HDPE plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid soap, shampoo, or conditioner and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the reservoir for the liquid.
